Title: Overgrown Urban
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oubOHvu.gif[/img] 

Recommended to play with either one of the dlcs, as they add some food and stuff, but it should be fine without. Connects to The Mast (the main connection), Underpass and Arid Barrens!

After a year of nonstop work on this, its finally done. Explore tall mazes of old and overgrown structures of a pre-iterator city. Part of my own small rainworld expansion.

Features: 
- custom sleep screen art
- 100+ rooms, all with detailed and high effort backgrounds
- tons of amazing music
- unique worldstates for some slugcats ([spoiler]and bad warp[/spoiler]  worldstate for the Watcher)
- custom graffiti and Ancient/Benefactor murals
- new [spoiler]Echo[/spoiler] ([spoiler] Shining Petals upon Endless Orchids [/spoiler])
- 4 new arenas
- 3 lore pearls (1 accesible for the Watcher in[spoiler]bad warp, with unique pearl reader interaction[/spoiler])
- optional Arid Barrens connection


Recommendations:
- I highly recommend playing as Survivor for the first time, enter from The Mast (enter from: [spoiler] TM_D06 [/spoiler]), and leave from Underpass. (Arid Barrens if you want a little faster way of traveling to LTTM with pearls)
- for second playtrough, I recommend either Spearmaster/Artificer, which both offer more harsh, challenging worldstate, almost feels like you're not supposed to be there.
